reference_source: seven frozen inputs/*.gb files listed by the panel; no reference files modified

thresholds.strict: same accession, start, end and strand
thresholds.relaxed_primary: same strand, >=50% of reference span and >=20% of prediction span
thresholds.relaxed_sensitivity: same strand, >=20% of reference span and >=20% reciprocal span
thresholds.intergenic: no overlap and nearest reference distance <=1000 nt
